hooks.name: Submission metrics check
hooks.description: When README or submission docs are saved, verifies every number matches docs/metrics JSON and that required disclaimers and links exist.

action.prompt: A submission-facing document was just saved. Read docs/metrics/*.json and verify that every performance or cost number in the saved file matches a value in those files. List any number that doesn't (the BRD forbids invented metrics). Also check for: the "synthetic data / simulated actions" disclaimer, the category/problem statement, the live Cloud Run URL, the video link (must be 3:00 or shorter), the repo link, and English-only text. Report in 6 bullets or fewer; don't change numbers yourself.
